video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Mavericks Postgame Interviews 10/14/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Pelicans' defensive connectivity and communication
quotes.excerpt: They were communicating with one another, flying around, covering for one another, doing it best without fouling.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Let's start with defense in the first half. It seemed like that might have been the best defensive half that we've seen so far in preseason. What did you think of the way the guys were connected and even into the third quarter when you had the rotation guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: I thought our guys were very connected. That's a great word. They were communicating with one another, flying around, covering for one another, doing it best without fouling. Again, we had I think two or three shot clock violations, and that's just their ability to sit down and take on the challenge of being the most physical team early to set the tone in the game.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praised his team defensive connectivity after holding the Pelicans to low scoring quarters. He noted the group was flying around and covering for one another while emphasizing that defense is what will get them over the top.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on team-wide defensive buy-in and communication
quotes.excerpt: They've all taken the challenge on and I think they believe that that's what's going to get you over the top.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: It seems like everybody, though, that that connection, that communication is is rising right now, kind of throughout the team, yeah?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: Well, they've all taken the challenge on and I think they believe that that's what's going to get you over the top. Being in so many games and understanding that we can score the ball at times, but defense sustains you. There's going to be things that we're going to have to clean up in our process of getting better, but I did like the effort, I like the energy, I like us flying around and more than covering for one another.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the team understands that while they can score the ball, defense is what sustains them. He likes the current energy and defensive buy-in but notes there are still things to clean up in their process.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on defensive communication and setting the tone
quotes.excerpt: These guys being able to fly around for one another is exactly what we've asked them to do.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Under 20 in the first and the third, is that the most this team looked like you want them to look like defensively tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: The communication. I think these guys being able to fly around for one another is exactly what we've asked them to do. We've watched film, the coaches are doing an unbelievable job of putting in the system, understanding what we need them to be doing, and again, I was very happy with their intensity and the way they start the game. I think it's so important how you walk into an NBA game, setting the tone early.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on the defensive intensity shown tonight. He credited the coaching staff for the system implementation and emphasized that setting the tone early is critical to how they walk into an NBA game.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on end-of-game decision making and communication
quotes.excerpt: End of games is going to be so important for us to continue to stay locked in.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The fourth quarter, how important is it for those guys to be in situations like that where you have to hold on to a lead, you have to have, you know, don't foul in the situation, you know, defend this three with point whatever left, just how important is it for those guys?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: It's critical. You can watch it on film. We talk about end of game decision making, end of game communication, talked about it in the locker room. Yes, we did win the game, but there are so many things that we can clean up. I think the understand what we're doing in the huddle, coming out of the huddle with the right lines of communication, but again, the compete level of each one of these guys is at a high level and that's what we're asking them to do and I think we can take it to up another notch. But end of games is going to be so important for us to continue to stay locked in in what we're doing in these situations.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley calls end of game decision making critical for his team. Even after a win, he says there are things to clean up regarding communication and execution in the final minutes of a game.
